a.text: Borrowed cognition, the product holds no model

b.text: Vinc stores, selects and proves, but never generates: extraction and phrasing come from the MCP host, which is what makes answers verifiable and also what makes the product an accessory to another runtime.

a.text: Chunk is the source of truth for document text

b.text: Source text exists only as offset-joined chunk text inside the graph, with no document blob column and no reference to an original file, so the source of truth survives the file being deleted.

a.text: The authorization gate for the remote profile

b.text: Protected-resource and authorization-server metadata, dynamic client registration and authorization codes with proof-key exchange, implementing the specification and nothing vendor specific, which is why two different browser assistants register against the same gate.

a.text: Plan entitlement: free, pro, and team

b.text: One source of truth for a person's entitlement, reaching the enforcement points by three routes that must all agree, because a discrepancy between them is invisible to the user.

a.text: The graph proxy allowlist, registered in three places

b.text: An operation reaches the browser only if it appears in the sidecar routes, the hub proxy operation map and the account read or write map, and missing one kills that feature quietly on the web alone.
The same frontend bundle as the desktop app with its data base path pointed at the account instead of a local sidecar, authenticated by the account session and at full write parity.
An isolated copy of the graph store used for controlled experiments. It is not the production account store, and it is not a separate benchmark set.
VINC compares embedding candidates on retrieval quality, runtime, storage, deployment reproducibility, and migration economics rather than model scores alone.
Wave 0 screening is the pre-fixture gate that eliminates or constrains embedding candidates using licence, artifact, and repository compatibility before expensive evaluation runs.

a.text: Quantization is Part of the Model

b.text: A quantized embedding artifact must be qualified with the execution kernel and actual CPU because runtime mismatch can change quality and performance.
Embedding candidates must be compared on the same corpus, queries, chunking, hardware, retrieval depth, and evaluation fixture.

a.text: AkasicDB as unified retrieval execution benchmark

b.text: AkasicDB는 vector, graph, relational 질의를 하나의 실행 framework에서 통합하는 DBMS로 VINC의 retrieval execution substrate 또는 benchmark 후보이다.
LadybugDB는 embedded analytical graph engine으로 현재 VINC의 저장·질의 실행 substrate에 적합하며 VINC는 그 위에서 ontology와 knowledge lifecycle을 소유한다.
VINC는 직접적인 memory DB나 graph DB가 아니라 지식의 의미·근거·결정·변경·검증·에이전트 활용을 관리하는 Knowledge Operating System으로 포지셔닝한다.
The single embedded graph driver, reached through one unconditional import, and when it is absent the store degrades to unreachable with the reason on the health route rather than crashing.

a.text: Vinc measured against agent-wiki, an outside build of the same idea

b.text: The comparative evaluation that treats an outside LLM-inside implementation as the null hypothesis Vinc must beat.

a.text: The hub, the hosted data plane

b.text: One container running the sidecar and the MCP server over a single embedded store on a mounted file share, pinned to exactly one replica because the store admits one writer.

a.text: In-process state on the account backend

b.text: Rate limit counters, the purge schedule and the release mail ceiling all live inside one process, so the limits hold only while the application stays pinned to a single replica.
